_why: What `portabaltica-func` actually carried when this was taken. `main.bicep` says what SHOULD be deployed; nothing in CI applies it, so the two can disagree silently and did. `newsroom/tests/pipeline/test_deployed_settings.py` compares them. Names only, never values: two of these are secrets.
_limitation: A recorded observation, not a live read. The unit suite has no network by design (newsroom/tests/conftest.py), so this file is as current as the last person to refresh it. It catches a template that grew a setting nobody deployed; it cannot catch a setting removed from the app after this was taken. The live check belongs in the deploy workflow.
_history: Taken first at 07:58Z, when NEWSROOM_WEEKLY_SCHEDULE was ABSENT — declared in main.bicep since #108 (2026-08-27) and never deployed, so the app ran on its code default and the Bicep parameter was a dead knob. Deployed at 08:12Z with `az functionapp config appsettings set`, value unchanged at '0 0 15 * * 0', so no behaviour changed. Writing a setting restarts the app; newsroom_weekly was confirmed still registered afterwards, four hours before it was due to fire.
command: az functionapp config appsettings list -n portabaltica-func -g portabaltica-rg --query "[].name" -o tsv | sort
